import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


class PreflightTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_fixture(self, xml, bundle=False):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="voyager-fcpxml-") as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            media = root / "clip with space & audio.mov"
            media.write_bytes(b"scratch media reference")
            target = root / "handoff.fcpxml"
            argument = target
            if bundle:
                argument = root / "handoff.fcpxmld"
                argument.mkdir()
                target = argument / "Info.fcpxml"
            relative = target.parent / "Media"
            relative.mkdir()
            (relative / "clip with space & audio.mov").write_bytes(b"relative media")
            target.write_text(xml.replace("MEDIA", media.as_uri().replace("&", "&")), encoding="utf-8")
            before = target.read_bytes()
            result = subprocess.run(["python3", str(Path(__file__).with_name("preflight.py")), str(argument)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), before)
            return result.returncode, json.loads(result.stdout)

    def test_modern_bundle_and_rational_time(self):
        code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml version="1.11"><resources><format id="f" frameDuration="1001/30000s"/><asset id="a"><media-rep kind="original-media" src="MEDIA"/></asset></resources><library><event><project><sequence format="f" duration="1001/30s"><spine><asset-clip ref="a" offset="0s" start="-1s" duration="1001/30s"/></spine></sequence></project></event></library></fcpxml>', bundle=True)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(result["media"][0]["exists"])

    def test_relative_media_in_document_and_bundle(self):
        for bundle in (False, True):
            code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml><resources><asset id="a"><media-rep kind="original-media" src="./Media/clip%20with%20space%20%26%20audio.mov"/></asset></resources></fcpxml>', bundle=bundle)
            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(result["unchecked_media"], [])
            self.assertTrue(result["media"][0]["exists"])
        code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml><resources><asset id="a" src="./Media/missing.mov"/></resources></fcpxml>')
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["missing_media"]), 1)

    def test_missing_proxy_and_original(self):
        code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml><resources><asset id="a"><media-rep kind="original-media" src="MEDIA"/><media-rep kind="proxy-media" src="file:///unavailable/proxy.mov"/></asset></resources></fcpxml>')
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["missing_media"][0]["kind"], "proxy-media")
        self.assertTrue(result["media"][0]["exists"])

    def test_invalid_references_times_and_duplicates(self):
        code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml><resources><format id="f" frameDuration="1/0s"/><format id="f"/></resources><asset-clip ref="missing" duration="-1s" offset="1.5s"/></fcpxml>')
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["errors"]), 5)

    def test_inline_title_text_styles(self):
        xml = '<fcpxml version="1.11"><resources><effect id="title"/></resources><title ref="title"><text><text-style ref="style">Hello</text-style></text><text-style-def id="style"><text-style font="Helvetica"/></text-style-def></title></fcpxml>'
        code, result = self.run_fixture(xml)
        self.assertEqual((code, result["errors"]), (0, []))
        code, result = self.run_fixture(xml.replace('ref="style"', 'ref="missing"'))
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"][0]["ref"], "missing")
        code, result = self.run_fixture(xml.replace('ref="title"', 'ref="style"'))
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"][0]["tag"], "title")

    def test_legacy_and_remote_media(self):
        code, result = self.run_fixture('<fcpxml><resources><asset id="a" src="MEDIA"/><asset id="b" src="https://example.com/video.mov"/></resources></fcpxml>')
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["unchecked_media"]), 1)

    def test_malformed_and_entity_inputs(self):
        for xml in ('<mlt/>', '<fcpxml>', '<!DOCTYPE fcpxml [<!ENTITY x "abc">]><fcpxml/>'):
            code, result = self.run_fixture(xml)
            self.assertEqual(code, 2)
            self.assertIn("error", result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

When choosing takes, lines or cut points from footage, follow [local footage review](../edit-video/SKILL.md#review-footage-locally) first.

Use the bundled read-only helper before handing off or troubleshooting FCPXML:

```sh
python3 scripts/preflight.py /absolute/cut.fcpxml
```

Resolve `scripts/` relative to this skill's directory. `.fcpxmld` bundles are
accepted; the helper reads `Info.fcpxml`. It checks resource references,
duplicate IDs, rational times and local media paths, including document-relative URLs and modern
`media-rep` originals/proxies. Exit 1 means preflight findings; exit 2 means
unreadable/unsupported input. `unchecked_media` requires separate inspection.
A missing proxy can be harmless when the original exists.

On macOS, hand the checked FCPXML (or `.fcpxmld` bundle) to whichever Final Cut
edition is installed. Use the detected `final-cut` capability's `appPath` with
`open -a "/absolute/path/to/Final Cut Pro Creator Studio.app" "/absolute/cut.fcpxml"`
(substitute the actual detected app path). If no app path was detected, try both
registered bundle IDs, standalone first and Creator Studio second:

```sh
open -b com.apple.FinalCut "/absolute/cut.fcpxml" ||
  open -b com.apple.FinalCutApp "/absolute/cut.fcpxml"
```

The editions are named `Final Cut Pro` and `Final Cut Pro Creator Studio`.
If neither opens, report the launch error; do not claim an import succeeded.
Opening the file requests import; confirm the timeline in Final Cut before
reporting it as imported.

Do not construct or modify `.fcpbundle` internals.
